Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


I completely agree with you Meej. What you have said above is 100%
what the intended effect most likely is. However, that is not what the
card states. The card's use of "this Assamite" has other meanings,
amongst which is that if the Assamite changes clan to whatever, he/she
can longer use the ability. So the card cannot be used if the bearer
is not an Assamite, and/or if the previous bearer this turn who was an
Assamite did make use of the card's effect. Which is not what it says,
but what it's effect is.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Blooded Sand wrote:
> So the card cannot be used if the bearer
> is not an Assamite, and/or if the previous bearer this turn who was an
> Assamite did make use of the card's effect. Which is not what it says,
> but what it's effect is.

That's what the card says. "Once per turn".

Once per turn, <some effect>.

Where <some effect> is conditional upon the bearer being Assamite and ready.

The card text "once per turn" means that if the effect was used already this
turn, then it cannot be used again this turn.
